history.change_from_previous: Revision 39f2597a (1045 manuscript commits after a284420) adds front matter, appendices and figures (47 new TeX inputs, among them the no-go appendix files), and added lines in 27 integrated files. The revision renames the appendix-local direct-bound constant C_2 to C_dir (C_dir^gen) in P:d1-upper, P:low-alpha-upper and C:planar-range; the intrinsic C_2(Gamma,a) is unchanged, and the companion follows the rename in prose only. The revision clarifies the attribution of the quoted source result T:first to X. Chen's paper (the source's own covariance and homogeneity assumptions, and a sentence that the quoted result is not extended to every covariance of H:homog); this is wording only, the companion does not formalize T:first, and no statement it cites changed. The revision adds a front-guide paragraph pointing readers to L:white-test and P:nogo-05 (four lines, wording only). The revision adds explanatory sentences to 207 of the book's 249 proofs (a readability pass; one more proof, of P:original-signed-point-upper, changes only by an original-text correction listed below); every statement, display, label and reference is kept, and every old proof line is kept word for word except 50 reworded lines and 32 re-wrapped ones (28 and 15 of them in the proof of L:cutoff-factorization, the sample proof the author approved, which the companion does not formalize); the companion's line citations into rewritten proofs were moved with the pass's per-file line maps. The revision corrects six places of the original text at the author's decision: two unparsable sentences in the proofs of T:intrinsic-second-moment and P:original-signed-point-upper, a garbled clause in the proof of L:point-fast-sources, and three typographical errors in the statements of P:masked-source-moments, P:source-gaussian-transfer and L:signed-score-envelope; none of these results is formalized here. The revision removes an unused setup step from the proof of P:symplectic-block-mean, which the companion does not formalize. Every one of the 452 labels cited by the companion exists exactly once in the include closure at 39f2597a. 8915 TeX line locators were read (generated comparator copies included): 227 unchanged, 6531 moved by the git diff of their file, each with the same text at both revisions (up to the C_dir rename), 563 in rewritten proofs located through the rewrite's line maps, every cited line kept word for word with explanatory sentences inserted between them, 1 located the same way with its words kept but re-wrapped around inserted explanatory sentences, and 1593 resolved by hand (file attribution confirmed or corrected by reading; 12 already wrong at a284420 corrected). Earlier waves were anchored to 975feb3 and then a284420.
